entries.text: `apply_rewrite` tests pin the named registry: every TPC-Havoc, Spark, DataFusion and engine rewrite in the bundled SQLGlot runtime resolves by name, an unlisted runtime function fails the registry test, and every compat, subqueries, date-arithmetic and alias-deduplication rewrite has a documented-output test. The list-aggregate, zero-divisor, ORDER BY alias, ClickHouse alias and decimal-division and rollup-NULL rewrites added in 30.24.0.9 are pinned and have documented-output tests too.
